Web design, explained

What is
scrolly­telling?

Why the best product pages feel like a short film.

In one line

Scrolling drives the story.

As the visitor scrolls, images, 3D objects and text animate in sequence. The page becomes cinematic, and the visitor stays in control of the pace.

Four ways to build it
01Image sequences: photographic quality, heavier download
02Video scrubbing: lighter, but needs careful encoding
03Real-time 3D (WebGL): fully interactive, rotate and configure
04CSS scroll timelines: light reveals and parallax, no JavaScript

Our Emerald Earring page

210 frames, scrubbed by your scroll.

Making it fast
→Modern formats such as WebP or AVIF
→Show the first frames at once, stream the rest
→A lighter sequence for phones
→Key text in real HTML, so search engines can read it

Is it right for you?

Yes, when the product is the hero.

Jewellery, fragrance, architecture, devices, vehicles. For a simple service page it is usually a distraction.
